scores.transition_note: Layout transitions (initial→Visible and between layouts) interpolate smoothly using cubic easing with no teleporting, origin clustering, or offscreen flight; programmatic checks confirm zero offscreen nodes and stable counts throughout. The Randomize Data action causes a visible blank frame at ~100ms because the code explicitly calls nodeG.selectAll('g.node').remove() before rebuild, producing a flash-to-empty rather than a cross-fade; nodes then fade in cleanly. Bundling slider and hover/click interactions work correctly with no artifacts.
scores.visual_critic_note: Dark aesthetic and clean control-bar typography show design intent, but tension at 0.01 makes edge bundles nearly invisible through the center, the radial layout is asymmetrically clustered, and 9px labels are at the edge of readability.
